title: 🐛  Missing Validation -  Empty Name / Goal allowed
body: Currently it is allowed to create agents with a blank goal / name, this should not be allowed ideally.

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
This is an agent issue because it concerns agent workflow and configuration—specifically, the validation of agent creation parameters (name/goal), which are core to agent initialization and operation. Allowing blank values can lead to workflow anomalies or improper agent behavior.
